name: Jiangsu Yangdian Science & Technology Co. Ltd.
summary: Jiangsu Yangdian Science & Technology Co. Ltd. specializes in the research, manufacturing, and distribution of amorphous alloy transformers. The company offers a comprehensive range of products, primarily focusing on advanced transformer technology. This includes various amorphous alloy cores, different transformer types such as the oil-immersed S(B) H15 series, S13 series three-dimensional and laminated core transformers, and dry-type amorphous alloy transformers. They also supply combined transformer substations and integrated amorphous alloy core transformers. Beyond finished transformers, Jiangsu Yangdian also manufactures specialized machinery essential for transformer production. This equipment encompasses high-voltage automatic wire winding machines, foil coil winding machines, automatic cutting lines for amorphous alloy metal cores, and various assembly and handling stands like active part assembly stands, core roll-over stands, amorphous ribbon material turn-over stands, and layer insulation folding machines. Established in 1993, the firm operates from its headquarters in Taizhou, China.
